mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, indicating a contraction in manufacturing output, the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% and year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized, the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
